en: Windows: Improved start-up time with no Git Bash and no `pwsh` on PATH by checking PowerShell's standard install locations at once; System32's `powershell.exe` now wins over one earlier on PATH
zh: Windows：改进在没有 Git Bash 且 PATH 中没有 `pwsh` 时的启动时间，通过同时检查 PowerShell 的标准安装位置；System32 中的 `powershell.exe` 现在优先于 PATH 中更靠前的 `powershell.exe`
